"THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced Ugly-Eyes and lived to sit here. They faced The Eater and lived to sit here. 2 more of the later drafts faced besides. Even now the wave-4 bar reads: put weapons in hands (3 of 5 armed); blood your fighters (0 of 1 veterans). Even now the wave-5 bar reads: armor the village (3 of 4 fighters armored); put weapons in hands (3 of 6 armed); blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans)." — the System is still reading the list.
